title: Hacking gang CyberLeek claims it released all files for the Xbox build of GTA VI, including an executable program that could help modders port the game to PC (Michael Kan/PCMag)
summary: Michael Kan / PCMag: Hacking gang CyberLeek claims it released all files for the Xbox build of GTA VI, including an executable program that could help modders port the game to PC — The CyberLeek hacking gang claims to have released a key executable program that promises to help the modding community port Grand Theft Auto 6 to the PC.
